say:2:1410247001:1.text: Wow, impressive... this is way beyond what I expected! Thank Helthor!
say:2:1410247001:1.source_cn: 哇呼！绝了……超越预期！感谢赫托！

say:3:1410247002:1.text: By channeling the transmission with magic, the energy efficiency is through the roof! It's like I've created something that could rival Helthor's finest work!
say:3:1410247002:1.source_cn: 通过魔力进行传输引导，聚能效率前所未有地增加！比肩赫托...

say:4:1410247003:1.text: You must not be an ordinary mage... I've worked with mages centuries ago, and none of them ever produced results like this!
say:4:1410247003:1.source_cn: 你一定不是普通的魔法师……几百年前我也曾经和魔法师合作...
say:4:1410247003:1.male: You must not be an ordinary mage... I've worked with mages centuries ago, and none of them ever produced results like this!
say:4:1410247003:1.female: You must not be an ordinary mage... I've worked with mages centuries ago, and none of them ever produced results like this!

choice_prompt:5:1410247003.text: You must not be an ordinary mage... I've worked with mages centuries ago, and none of them ever produced results like this!
choice_prompt:5:1410247003.source_cn: 你一定不是普通的魔法师……几百年前我也曾经和魔法师合作过，效果差远了！
choice_prompt:5:1410247003.male: You must not be an ordinary mage... I've worked with mages centuries ago, and none of them ever produced results like this!
choice_prompt:5:1410247003.female: You must not be an ordinary mage... I've worked with mages centuries ago, and none of them ever produced results like this!

say:6:1410247004:2.text: Zanie, you look like a kid. How old are you, really?
say:6:1410247004:2.source_cn: 祖娅，你看上去是小孩子，你究竟多大了啊？

say:7:1410247005:1.text: You're being rude now, little familiar! Didn't your magister teach you not to ask a lady her age?
say:7:1410247005:1.source_cn: 没礼貌的小使魔！你家主人没教过你不可以随便问女性的年龄吗！
say:7:1410247005:1.male: You're being rude now, little familiar! Didn't your magister teach you not to ask a lady her age?
say:7:1410247005:1.female: You're being rude now, little familiar! Didn't your magister teach you not to ask a lady her age?

say:8:1410247007:1.text: Dwarves live a bit longer than humans, okay? I just... look a little younger than what people think.
say:8:1410247007:1.source_cn: 我们矮人一族的寿命本来就稍微长一些，我也只是……长得年...

say:10:1410247008:0.text: Just a little younger... Just a little?
say:10:1410247008:0.source_cn: 一点点……真的只有一点点吗？

say:11:1410247009:0.text: Forget it, forget it! Since you're helping so much, I won't hold it against you. But first, let me check my adorable little treasure.
say:11:1410247009:0.source_cn: 算了算了……看在你们帮大忙的份上，我不计较。我先看看我...

say:13:1410247010:1.text: Hmm... I'll need to add a targeting device here. After I boost its strength and precision, I'll have to calibrate it manually. Also—
say:13:1410247010:1.source_cn: 嗯……这里得加上个瞄准装置，强度和精度上升以后必须得人...

say:14:1410247011:1.text: Zanie! Remember our deal, get us up there first!
say:14:1410247011:1.source_cn: 祖娅！别忘了我们约好的，先把我们送上去。

say:16:1410247012:1.text: I haven't forgotten! But you need to be quiet while I fine-tune a few things...
say:16:1410247012:1.source_cn: 没忘没忘，但你们先安静点，让我调整几个设置……

say:20:1410247014:1.text: Two hours! Not a second more, I swear!
say:20:1410247014:1.source_cn: 两个小时！一秒不多，一秒不少！两个小时绝对完成！

say:22:1410247015:1.text: But we need to leave as soon as possible!

say:24:1410247016:0.text: Hmm... this screw needs replacing, and the expansion nails probably need a material tweak, or...
say:24:1410247016:0.source_cn: 嘶……这个螺丝得换，膨胀钉的材质是不是也都得对应调整，...

say:27:1410247018:1.text: *Sigh* I think she's in her own little world now. What do we do?
say:27:1410247018:1.source_cn: 唉，她好像已经听不见我们说话了。现在该怎么办呢？

say:28:1410247019:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we try contacting General Hogan? I wonder how things are going on his end.
say:28:1410247019:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we try contacting General Hogan? I wonder how things are going on his end.
say:28:1410247019:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we try contacting General Hogan? I wonder how things are going on his end.

say:29:1410247020:1.text: We did make a big ruckus in the mine. I hope we didn't cause him any trouble.
say:29:1410247020:1.source_cn: 我们在矿洞弄出这么大的动静……希望不会给他添麻烦。

choice_prompt:30:1410247020.text: We did make a big ruckus in the mine. I hope we didn't cause him any trouble.
choice_prompt:30:1410247020.source_cn: 我们在矿洞弄出这么大的动静……希望不会给他添麻烦。

say:31:1410247021:1.text: Okay, this place is right under the mine they got blocked off. There could be some dwarven secrets around here.
say:31:1410247021:1.source_cn: 也好……这个地方确实值得探索，就在他们拦着我们不让看的...

say:32:1410247022:1.text: We can report our findings to General Hogan later!
say:32:1410247022:1.source_cn: 收集到的情报，待会可以一起汇报给霍根将军！

say:33:1410247023:1.text: Oh, right! No one's around, and Zanie's completely absorbed in her work!
say:33:1410247023:1.source_cn: 对哦！这里正好没什么外人，祖娅又在埋头研究！

say:34:1410247024:1.text: Magister, let's take a quick look around!
say:34:1410247024:1.source_cn: 主人，我们先在研究所内看看吧！
say:34:1410247024:1.male: Magister, let's take a quick look around!
say:34:1410247024:1.female: Magister, let's take a quick look around!

choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 霍根能处理，我们先查查这里

choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 在周围转转，这里可能有情报

say:36:1410247006:1.text: Hey! It's rude to ask a woman her age!
say:36:1410247006:1.source_cn: 喂！问女性年龄也太失礼了吧！
